author: Unity
description:
We heard you loud and clear 🔊 Introducing the official Unity plugin for OpenAI’s Codex - a first-party integration available now directly in OpenAI’s universal plugin directory.

Developers are already using OpenAI’s Codex for Unity, but now with our official plugin, your agent gets direct engine expertise written and maintained by Unity’s own engineers:
✅ Higher Accuracy: Instructions written and kept current by the Unity teams that own each system, so the details come out right the first time.
✅ First-party Skills: Teaches Codex how Unity development is actually done, right out of the box.
✅ Unity from your Terminal:  The Unity CLI skill installs Editors, creates and opens projects, and manages packages.

Get it in one click from the OpenAI plugin directory.

🔗 Get started: https://on.unity.com/OpenAIPlugin

#Unity #OpenAI #Codex #GameDev
title: Introducing the official Unity plugin for OpenAI Codex
